description: MONITOR DE SECAS ES is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). O Monitor de Secas é um processo de acompanhamento regular e periódico da situação da seca no Brasil, cujos resultados consolidados são divulgados por meio do Mapa do Monitor de Secas. O mapa é mensal e apresenta a situação de seca nas unidades federativas no mês anterior, além das áreas que ficaram livres do fenômeno. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are ANA, es, INMET, MINISTERIO DA INTEGRACAO NACIONAL, MONITOR DE SECAS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
